name: marginalia
description: Marginalia turns folders of LaTeX books, Markdown notes and PDFs into a study website with search, highlights, typed notes, handwriting and AI study tools that use your own model.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:node && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/app.ts src/client/notes.ts src/client/ink.ts src/client/nav.ts src/client/pdf.ts src/client/ai.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap --outdir=dist/client && esbuild src/client/ai-anthropic.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=dist/client/ai-anthropic.mjs
